title: Split button
description: The main action and a ▾ that opens a Menu of the other ways to do the same job (Thêm khách hàng | ▾ Nhập từ file, Tìm trong Data Hub). One filled button in total; below sm one button opens the whole list, the main action first.
when: Two or more ways to start one job (type it in, import a file, copy from another system): G1.
A detail header or side panel action with variants (Gửi hỏi giá | ▾ Gửi từ mẫu, Gọi điện).

instead.need: A toggle or the steps of one control (view mode, ‹ Hôm nay ›)

a11y: A group named by the main label; the ▾ is a menu button (aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded) with its own name (menuLabel); the menu follows Menu's keyboard.

examples.title: In a toolbar
examples.description: Narrow the window below sm: one button opens Thêm khách hàng and its alternatives.

examples.title: Full width (workspace action bar)
examples.description: `fullWidth` stretches the primary button across its container (e.g. WorkspaceLayout's pinned action bar) and keeps the split trigger on phones.
